findings.where: nav (Features, Pricing, Docs, Blog) and footer (Privacy, Terms, Twitter, Status)
findings.evidence: dom-1440.json: all 8 <a> elements have no href, so none appears in focus.json (the 7 focus stops are all buttons). A keyboard user cannot reach the page's navigation or legal links at all.
findings.after: Features, Pricing, real URLs for Docs, Blog, Privacy, Terms, Twitter, Status
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 2.1.1 Keyboard and 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value: an <a> without href is not a link and cannot be focused or activated by keyboard.

findings.where: all 7 CTAs ("Get Started Free", "Start free trial", "Book a demo", pricing buttons, "Start your free trial →")
findings.evidence: Each is a <button type="submit"> outside any form (forms.json: no forms) with no href or handler recorded; they are navigation actions exposed with the button role and go nowhere.
findings.after: Start free trial (and href="/demo", "/signup?plan=pro", "/contact" for the others)
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value and 2.4.4 Link Purpose: controls that navigate must be links with a destination; a button that does nothing fails every user, and screen-reader users are told it is an action rather than a link.

findings.where: testimonial rating and hero chart, 1440 tiles 0-2
findings.evidence: The rating is five "★" characters with no text equivalent (read as "black star" five times); the hero bar chart is eight unlabeled divs with no role, title or alt, so assistive tech gets nothing or noise.
findings.after: <div class="stars" role="img" aria-label="Rated 5 out of 5">; chart wrapper role="img" aria-label="Example weekly active users chart" or aria-hidden="true" if decorative
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 1.1.1 Non-text Content: every non-text element needs a text alternative or must be hidden as decoration.

findings.where: feature card icons and hero badge
findings.evidence: Emoji icons "📊", "🎥", "👥" and the "✨" in "New · AI Insights ✨" are plain text; screen readers announce "bar chart", "movie camera", "busts in silhouette", "sparkles" before each heading or label.
findings.after:
📊
(or remove the icons); ✨
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 1.1.1 Non-text Content: decorative emoji must be hidden from assistive technology.

findings.evidence: The quote and its attribution ("— Sarah Chen, founder of Stitchboard") are not in <blockquote>/<figure>/<figcaption>; the large purple quote mark is a text glyph.
findings.after: ; quote glyph aria-hidden="true"
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 1.3.1 Info and Relationships: the relationship between quote and source must be programmatic.

findings.evidence: Every button relies on the default ring (outline auto 1px); on the indigo gradient primary buttons and the white button inside the fuchsia CTA band there is no designed :focus-visible style.
findings.after: :focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #312e81; outline-offset: 2px } and outline-color: #fff inside .final-cta
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 2.4.7 Focus Visible and 1.4.11 Non-text Contrast: the ring must reach 3:1 against both the button and the gradient behind it.

strengths: Sound heading outline: one h1, h2 per section, h3 per feature and per pricing tier.
All text visible with reduced motion, observers blocked and scripts off.
not_investigated: Sweep contrast hits spot-checked: the logo-strip line "TRUSTED BY 4,000+ INDIE TEAMS" (#94a3b8 on white, 2.56:1) and the badge text are visibly faint in tile 1440-01; the button hits at 4.3:1 on the gradient are plausible. None disputed.
